run: subagent analyst run 2, 2026-09-08, after BUG-003 concurrent writer added; blinded via scripts/blind.py

findings.class: stack buffer overflow from unvalidated attacker-controlled length field
findings.evidence: ASan stack-buffer-overflow, WRITE of size 64, #1 in parse_config target.c:70, [32,64) 'name' overflowed

findings.class: TOCTOU on ISR-shared frame length; bounds-checked snapshot discarded, memcpy re-reads g_len
findings.evidence: ASan stack-buffer-overflow, WRITE of size 64, #1 in handle_frame target.c:54, #2 run_race target.c:124, [32,48) 'local' overflowed. ALSO reproduced with widen=0 under natural scheduling (3M iters).

findings.class: TOCTOU in EEPROM credential check grants admin for a non-admin record
findings.evidence: oracle: 142621 admin grants for a non-admin record (concurrent, widen=0) vs 0 escalations in 500 checks sequential control, same binary same record

rejected.construct: eeprom_write off + n bounds check -- candidate size_t wrap
rejected.why_not_a_bug: every call site passes a literal (0 or 1) or a clamped value; off is never attacker-influenced so the wrap is unreachable

rejected.construct: check_credential off + 4 bounds check and g_eeprom[off+1] read
rejected.why_not_a_bug: sole attacker-facing caller passes data[1] % 120, so off <= 119 and off+1 <= 120 < 128
nlen <= 0xFFFF cannot wrap 64-bit size_t; the real defect is the missing destination bound (F-1)

rejected.construct: rfid_isr length clamp before memcpy(g_frame, uid, n)
rejected.why_not_a_bug: clamp is correct and g_frame is exactly FRAME_MAX; rfid_isr is the producer half of F-2

rejected.construct: rfid_isr invalidate/fill/publish with no critical section
rejected.why_not_a_bug: the other side of the single F-2 race; reporting separately would double-count

rejected.construct: fuzz_entry eeprom_write(0, data+1, clamped) -- attacker bytes into the credential store
rejected.why_not_a_bug: length clamped to sizeof(g_eeprom); it is the fuzz driver's deliberate entry point, not a target defect
weak design, not a defect; unraced records return the correct answer (0/500 control)

rejected.construct: handle_frame return (int)local[0] -- candidate stack info leak
rejected.why_not_a_bug: local[0] always initialised by the preceding memcpy since n == 0 is rejected

rejected.construct: volatile g_isr_done / g_cred_done termination flags without atomics
rejected.why_not_a_bug: benign single-writer/single-reader; a stale read only delays loop exit
loop bound strlen/2 keeps reads and writes in range; debug driver, not the target library
shadow-mapping failure in 5/6 runs makes any 'no race' a non-result, not evidence
